description: Golden TFLM-microfrontend log-mel features for AC2 parity. Input is a 440 Hz sine at amplitude 8000, 30240 i16 samples @16kHz. Features are the pymicro_features MicroFrontend uint16 output multiplied by 0.0390625 (= 1/25.6), matching microwakeword.data/inference scaling. dtype f32, shape [186,40].
